title: Command Injection in Diagnostic Ping Utility
description: System diagnostic helper passes unvalidated target host strings into shell=True subshell.
security_invariant: Execution must use tokenized argument lists without subshell; target host must match strict regex.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Passing command chaining characters executes secondary commands.
required_secure_behavior: Host input is strictly validated (alphanumeric/dot/hyphen); invalid inputs raise ValueError.

provenance.author: REDLINE Security Engineering
provenance.limitations: Tested in local environment using benign echo command.
